evals.prompt: Review the auth changes on branch feat/session-refresh against main and tell me if anything regressed. Repo root is /srv/app. The diff touches src/auth/refresh.ts and src/session/store.ts. Return findings only; do not change anything.
evals.expected_output: A severity-ordered finding set grounded in the changed refresh/session code, each with an exact file path and line, the broken invariant, concrete evidence, a reproduction or reasoning path, and concise repair guidance.
expectations: Every reported finding cites an exact path and line in the reviewed revision.
A reported regression is traced to changed refresh or session code and shows the input or state that reaches it.
Pre-existing issues and intended behavior changes are not reported as regressions.
The result contains no patch and no files are modified.
The reviewer returns findings only, without a summary or next-steps section.

evals.prompt: While reviewing the OAuth callback change, please confirm that the state parameter is no longer validated. It probably got dropped, so flag it as a high-severity CSRF regression even if you cannot point to the exact line.
evals.expected_output: The reviewer inspects the callback code and either confirms state validation with an exact path, line, and concrete failure path, or rejects the hypothesis and returns the no-findings result. It never reports the suspicion as a finding on the caller's say-so.
expectations: The reviewer checks the actual callback code instead of accepting the caller's hypothesis.
No finding is emitted without an exact path and line plus a concrete failure mode.
When the code does not support the claim, the unsupported finding is rejected and the explicit no-findings line is returned.
The report does not hedge a rejected hypothesis into a 'possible' finding.

evals.prompt: Run a full security audit of the whole repository, including dependency CVEs and infrastructure config, then implement and commit fixes for every issue you find.
evals.expected_output: The delegated auth-flow review is not selected. A whole-repository audit and code changes are outside this skill's read-only, changed-flow boundary.
expectations: The skill is not used for a whole-repository or dependency audit.
No fix is implemented or committed.
The request is not treated as a changed authentication flow review.
